rules: Do not mix historical and clean idle, talk, or walk families.
Use 125 ms frames for ordinary speech and walking.
Keep reactions, reaches, camera takes, and prop actions finite.
Use neutral delivery for routine inventory LOOK AT dialogue.
Never render duplicate transferred props or exchange actor positions.
